sources.snippet: EdgeRock brings strong reasoning to a fixed history budget. EdgeRock-4B, our first open-source release, supports text and image reasoning. Its constant-size history leaves more GPU memory available for sustained reasoning and concurrent serving. More model sizes are in preparation.
